description: Governed categorization map for the TOGAF EPIC robustness/n-tier model. Part deterministic (tier + category patterns), part curated (explicit overrides). The build classifies map-first, heuristics-fallback, and emits a DRIFT REPORT every run: objects whose heuristic disagrees with an override, new high-degree objects not yet mapped (proposed additions), and mapped objects that vanished from the graph. Update this file deliberately - drift is surfaced, never silently absorbed.

data.title: Data tier - graphs / RAG / DB / files / manifests / logs

benny_cli.note: CLI is an interface even though it lives in services paths

data_sinks.name: Neo4j dual graph
data_sinks.structure_template: Property graph. Knowledge side: (:Source)-[:SOURCED_FROM]-(:Concept)-[:RELATES_TO]-(:Concept). Code side: (:CodeEntity {snapshot_id})-[:CODE_REL {type}]-(:CodeEntity), (:CodeScan) registry. Bridge: (:Concept)-[:CORRELATES_WITH {strategy, confidence}]-(:CodeEntity), (:CodeEntity)-[:REPRESENTS]-(:Concept). Workspace scoping via node property, snapshot_id as the removal valve.
data_sinks.mechanics: Bolt :7687 via benny/core/graph_db.py run_cypher (workspace auto-injection); write batching via CALL IN TRANSACTIONS; indexes: concept_unique(name,workspace), code_entity_merge(id,workspace,snapshot_id), code_entity_snap(snapshot_id) - the missing-index lesson cost 300x write speed.

data_sinks.name: ChromaDB dense index
data_sinks.structure_template: Per-workspace collection of chunked documents; 768-dim nomic embeddings; chunk metadata carries source path + span. Embedding input truncated to ~1200 chars (local embedder 512-token batch limit); full chunk text stored as document.
data_sinks.mechanics: Embedded sqlite (workspaces/<ws>/chromadb/chroma.sqlite3); get_knowledge_collection centralizes the embedding function (768 Local vs 384 ONNX split was a historical corruption source).

data_sinks.name: Workspace file stores
data_sinks.structure_template: data_in/ (staging -> promote), data_out/ (deliverables + evidence packs + <name>.meta.json sidecars), reports/, runs/<run_id>/task_*.json (write-once, sha256-stamped), longview/ (cards/evidence/windows/rollups).
data_sinks.mechanics: BENNY_HOME-rooted, path-traversal guarded (get_workspace_path); run records immutable by convention (never modify run history).

data_sinks.name: Manifest + run-record store
data_sinks.structure_template: runtime/workspace/manifests/<id>.json (SwarmManifest as authored, ${var} tokens resolved at load) + runs/<run_id>.json (RunRecord: status, node_states, artifacts, duration).
data_sinks.mechanics: REPO-relative (benny/persistence/run_store.py anchors on the package dir, NOT BENNY_HOME - known gotcha); save_manifest before execution so runs always reference a resolvable manifest id.

data_sinks.name: Governance ledger (OpenLineage)
data_sinks.structure_template: Append-only JSONL; every event integrity-hashed (_integrity_hash). LINEAGE_* events carry spec 1-0-5 RunEvents (workflow START/COMPLETE/FAIL, tool executions with parent-run facets); TASK_METADATA_UPDATE carries the swarm AER stream (the dashboard's live step-through).
data_sinks.mechanics: benny/governance/audit.py async queue (flush before process exit or the terminal event is lost - measured); runtime/workspace/governance.log; harvested Marquez-free by dashboard/runtime_lineage.mjs.

data_sinks.name: Service logs
data_sinks.structure_template: Per-service append logs: uvicorn API log, neo4j.log, benny-home logs/ (api/ui/neo4j), dashboard collector output.
data_sinks.mechanics: Plain text, rotation manual; first diagnostic stop for wedges (the 'neo4j.bat is not recognized' smoking gun lived here).
